sellerPath.funds: safeTransferFrom(original owner,fixed pair,amountIn), then pair.swap USDT directly to owner; no intermediate custody.
sellerPath.naturalTokenOrder: Source1297: reward(from/to) then sync(true), getSellFee, pool burn/sync, profit/base fees and processFee, final remainder into pair. Seller reads reserves only after transfer finishes.
sellerPath.inputAccounting: soldInput tracks gross wallet debit; actualInput=post-transfer pair balance-reserve, bounded <=gross input. Small prior pool surplus can participate without altering gross accounting.
sellerPath.outputAccounting: USDT before/after pair.swap excludes earlier fee/referral income. Requested minimum must be positive and >=ceil(grossInput*fixed price/1e18). Failure reverts current chunk atomically; gas may still be spent in real transactions.
sellerPath.replayAndReentrancy: Task ID includes chain/contract/owner/nonce, active task/status and expected chunk index enforced, cumulative/maxChunk/window/gasPrice limits, global nonReentrant on state-changing methods.
sellerPath.partialExecution: Prior successful chunks remain completed; later failure rolls back only current transaction. Fresh pending rewards remain visible as residual; cap/chunk/dust stop is explicitly labelled.

externalDependency.detail: processFee uses V2/V3 Routers, AutoSwap, BNB recipients and IDOFundPool; it can alter reserves and incur dependency failures. Fund implementation public source unavailable; not declared audited.
externalDependency.snapshotTaxNote: Getter tax100 is a snapshot. sync(true) runs before actual fee determination and has separate reserve timestamp/day and block timestamp/mining-day logic; never promise next sell tax from prior getter alone.
